title: agrostis infirma var. sumatrana
intro: Agrostis infirma var. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran bentgrass, is a type of grass native to the Sumatran region in Indonesia. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The therapeutic actions of Sumatran bentgrass include soothing and calming effects, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant have not been extensively studied, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential medicinal properties.
